name: Eva Oyami
source:
Eva had served Heaven all her life, just like my mother. And when my mother told her that she was pregnant by a demon, she asked her to swear that she would take care of [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url] if she was in trouble. Eva swore, and when my mother was gone, she made sure that I would be all right.

[In game description]
